subject: MSA/DPA sequencing and MAP for HelioMed pilot
messages:
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@heliomed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form for HelioMed pilot

Hi Irene / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the pilot alignment looked great. Legal and procurement asked me to share a short list of required sequencing items so we can build a MAP and a concrete close timeline. High level asks from our side: 

- We need an MSA with our standard security & liability language in place before we sign the Order Form.
- A DPA must be reviewed and agreed in parallel; there are a couple of HelioMed-specific data retention clauses we will ask to confirm.
- Security evidence: SOC2 report (last 12 months) + brief runbook for data access requests.
- Acceptance milestones: pilot success criteria and a 7-day acceptance window after UAT.

Can you put together a proposed sequencing (owner + estimate days) and a MAP we can share with procurement? If you already have a redline-ready MSA we can route to our contracts team, that would speed things.

Attaching: Heliomed_contract_requirements.pdf (summary of our asks).

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Stone
Senior Legal Ops | HelioMed

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@heliomed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form for HelioMed pilot

Emily — thanks for the clear list. Putting a proposed sequencing below (high-level owners & target windows). Please confirm any constraints (e.g., internal signatory availability or external procurement windows) and we will lock the MAP.

Proposed sequencing (draft):
1) Legal redline pass (MSA) — Owner: Laura Bennett — 3 business days to initial redlines after receipt.
2) DPA review & security QA — Owner: Karthik Iyer / Security liaison — parallel to MSA, 4 business days. Karthik will pull SOC2 and complete DPA-QA worksheet.
3) Order Form prep (pricing + SOW) — Owner: Irene Choi — 2 business days after MSA redline alignment.
4) Procurement review & routing (HelioMed contracts) — Owner: HelioMed procurement — target 5 business days.
5) Signature (DocuSign) and pre-provisioning — Owner: Irene Choi / Ops — 2 business days.
6) Pilot UAT & acceptance window — 10 business day pilot followed by 7 day acceptance window.

Key dependency: We recommend locking a hard stop that the Order Form is not executed until MSA baseline and DPA are accepted — otherwise our billing and data controls can’t be finalized. If HelioMed needs the Order Form sooner we can discuss a conditional order with limited scope, but legal must confirm.

I’ll prepare a one-sheet MAP (owner / deliverable / date) and attach a first-pass MSA with inline comments (MSA-draft-v1_redlines.pdf) and a DPA questionnaire (DPA-QA.xlsx). Karthik — can you confirm SOC2 availability and whether Security needs more than the DPA-QA to complete their review?

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Stone <emily.stone@heliomed.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form for HelioMed pilot

Thanks — quick note from Security/Legal sequencing POV:

- SOC2: Full report available for FY2025 (cert issued Mar 2026). I will provide the summary + controls matrix by EOD tomorrow.
- DPA: the DPA-QA spreadsheet covers HelioMed clauses; I flagged two items (data retention window and subprocessors) that may need a short exception + documented compensating controls.
- Order Form gating: strongly recommend we keep the Order Form contingent on signed DPA. If procurement requires a signed Order Form earlier, propose a limited-scope PO (non-production) and a contractual hold point so we do not provision until DPA signed.

Attached: MSA-draft-v1_redlines.pdf (inline comments), DPA-QA.xlsx (security inputs).

Schedule check: if Laura can do a redline pass by Thu 6/12, we can route to HelioMed contracts on Mon 6/15 and target signature the week of 6/22 assuming procurement turnaround. That would align with a provisioning window the week after sign.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel (Contracts) | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@heliomed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form for HelioMed pilot

Irene / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple items from our side: 

- Procurement can accept a conditional PO to reserve pricing, but we need an explicit hold point in DocuSign before provisioning (we will not release payment without signed DPA).
- Our legal team asked for a short note describing Redwood’s data retention lifecycle (30/90/365 days by default) and a single point of contact for audit requests.
- Can you confirm the proposed sign week of 6/22? That works for our business sponsor, but only if we receive final redlines by end of day 6/15.

We are ready to review Laura's redlines; please route the MSA to contracts@heliomed.com and put me on the thread for any clarifications.

Emily
Emily Stone
Senior Legal Ops | HelioMed

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@heliomed.com>, contracts@heliomed.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Final MAP and next steps (HelioMed) — target sign week 6/22

Emily / HelioMed Contracts — attaching the MAP workbook (Heliomed_MAP_v20260615.xlsx) with owners, explicit hold points, and milestone dates. Executive summary below: 

- Target signature week: 2026-06-22 (contingent on HelioMed review of Laura's redlines by 6/15).
- Hold point: Order Form will be executed as a DocuSign envelope with a "Provisioning Hold" checkbox that prevents Ops from provisioning until DPA is signed.
- Security evidence: SOC2 FY2025 summary attached to HubSpot deal (link below). SSO and audit contact: security@redwood.com (primary), Karthik Iyer (legal lead).
- Next steps: 
  1) Laura to send redlined MSA to contracts@heliomed.com (sent)
  2) Karthik to upload SOC2 summary to HubSpot and complete DPA-QA (in progress)
  3) Schedule 30-min alignment call to confirm acceptance criteria and provisioning hold (suggest Wed 6/16 10:00am PT)

Related links: https://hubspot.com/deal/HLM-2026-042, https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/helio-map

If that schedule works, I will send the DocuSign envelope with the hold point language visible to your procurement team.

Thanks all — appreciate the fast collaboration.

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
